title: bench-v1 -- one benchmark run over one describe-* member
description: The shape of every file under an _XInfo folder's 6-bench/. 2-corpus is the RULER and never changes; 6-bench is the READING and there are many, so the two are different layers. A run names the code it graded, because a number with no commit is not a measurement.

bench.description: which of the three benchmarks produced this file

tag.description: the run's name, chosen by whoever ran it

git_head.description: the commit the graded code was at. dirty is marked.

profile.description: the member's declaration, echoed so a reader can see what was asserted without opening the source

n_fixtures.description: cases discovered under 5-api-examples for this member

n_records.description: individual result dicts the checks ran over

skipped.description: every case NOT replayed, with its reason. Never empty-by-omission: a benchmark that silently drops the hard cases reads as coverage it does not have.

checks.description: keyed C00..C11. Each carries the sentence it asserts, so the file is readable without the code.

why_na.description: required when status is NA. A check that opts out must say what it would have measured.
